title: 0.1% positive labels · re-calibrate the predicted probability
prompt: You have a dataset with **0.1% positive labels**. If you downsample the majority class by $100\times$ to train your classifier, your predicted probabilities will be artificially inflated. Write the exact Bayes' theorem formula to **re-calibrate the predicted probability** back to the true population prior $p_{\text{true}}$.
